event.description: Replace both attention output projections with identity and widen FF to 12
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 3,360 parameters at 99.070000%, a +0.070000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There are 0 prior attempts in this family, so no most recent accepted or failed in-family result exists. Attempt-0019 in normalization was a scored nonqualification at 0.01%, showing that another affine-bias deletion is not a safe local path. Hypothesis: concatenated two-head attention already returns a 16D residual-compatible vector, so learned 16x16 output mixing in both blocks can be replaced by identity; reallocating part of the 512-parameter saving to widen each FF bottleneck from 7 to 12 yields a 3,168-parameter representational substitution with more nonlinear capacity. This is more informative than the nearest untested one-block projection removal because it tests a coherent projection-free attention organization across depth while controlling for lost expressivity via budget reallocation.
